# proxmox_guest_firewall_refs (Data Source)

Lists guest firewall references from `GET /nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/firewall/refs`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_firewall_refs" "qemu" {
  type = "qemu"
  node = "pve"
  vmid = 100
}
```
